import re
def parse_gb(gb):
    length_match = re.search(r'LOCUS\s+\S+\s+(\d+)\s+bp', gb)
    cds_match = re.search(r'CDS\s+(\d+)\.\.(\d+)', gb)
    length = int(length_match.group(1)) if length_match else None
    cds_len = (int(cds_match.group(2)) - int(cds_match.group(1)) + 1) if cds_match else None
    return length, cds_len

plk4_tx_len, plk4_cds_len = parse_gb(gb_plk4)
arx_tx_len, arx_cds_len = parse_gb(gb_arx)

print(f"ARX: mRNA length = {arx_tx_len} bp, CDS length = {arx_cds_len} bp, Protein = {arx_cds_len // 3 - 1} aa")
